identityAlgorithm.numbers: finite binary64; -0 becomes +0; numeric leaf becomes {"$f64":"16 lowercase big-endian hexadecimal characters"}; booleans remain booleans
identityAlgorithm.objects: ASCII keys sorted ascending, reject original $f64 key; max depth32

function.inputRows: exact named finite-number-or-null feature mapping; no DSL evaluation in function evaluator
function.editRules: finite numeric values only; tree topology/splits/training metadata immutable; new content hash, parent hash, UNVALIDATED_USER_EDIT; original validation not inherited

diagnostics.ic: per-date cross-sectional correlation, minimum3 finite varying target pairs; equal-valid-date summary; single-asset unavailable
diagnostics.timeSeriesCorrelation: per-target Pearson/Spearman, explicitly not cross-sectional IC; target-id ordered cap32 with omitted count
diagnostics.descriptiveFit: pooled terminal-sample univariate OLS slope/intercept/R², no p-values or IID standard errors; not OOS incremental or causal contribution
diagnostics.jointDistribution: {x,y,status,xEdges,yEdges,counts,probabilities,sampleCount,missingPairCount,firstDate,lastDate,edgeSource,requestedBins,intervalConvention,interpretation}; null exterior edge denotes -/+infinity; empirical joint frequencies, not assumed density
diagnostics.jointSelection: first6 declared feature pairs, factors first; no outcome ranking; 5 requested quantile bins fixed from pre-terminal feature values, duplicate boundaries coalesced
diagnostics.significance: unavailable for factor-level tests because overlap/dependence not adjusted

selection.mechanism: family fixed by user before estimation
selection.candidates: predeclared finite estimator/regularization grid, hashed before fit
selection.choice: minimum inner mean MSE; within best-fold heuristic1SE prefer predeclared lower complexity
selection.warning: dependent folds and few folds: this is an explicit selection heuristic, never a confidence interval or promise of no bias/overfit
selection.evaluation: purged nested inner selection, outer estimate, untouched-for-selection terminal window; sequential refits only matured past labels
selection.budget: includes factor-free nested baseline branch plus both sequential refit attempts

cli: PYTHONPATH=engine python -m atlas_quant.statistical_quant.model_function function.json input.json --edits edits.json --output result.json
